roads.finish_status: Optional replacement study only; not merged into civil quantities. Existing2/8/2 road profile retained. No widening, extra layer or cosmetic stock adopted.
roads.marking_policy: If selected later, short pale dashes replace running-surface cells. Keep junctions, parcel entrances and maintenance openings clear; use explicit coordinate model before counting or construction.
roads.utility_policy: Offsets3/4 fluid reservations,5/6 clear walk,7/8 electrical reservations within each under-road gallery. These are civil reservations, not laid pipe/cable. At junctions, design separation and bend geometry after actual pipe/cable choice. Keep all access hubs and capped branches intact.
build_order: P0 create/survey PDIM and translate local coordinates
P1 nineteen existing northwest civil work orders
P4 parcel approach, cover, access and inspection
P5 water/fuel/Steam/LV commissioning one building at a time; permanent09-08/09-09 generation later
startup_sequence: 01-01 one boiler and steam process trial; add proposed second boiler only after measured demand
01-04 basic LV turbine and one consumer at a time
02-02 furnace after energy, coil, hatch and formation checks
commissioning: Inspect all chosen recipes and machine IDs in target GTNH2.9
Establish continuous water before fuel; follow actual machine warnings
Configure main/exhaust/output faces and covers; keep vent cells out of aisles
Select real pipes/cables, branch topology, voltage/amperage and losses
Test one recipe per machine, then simultaneous load and buffers
Record measured fuel/water/steam/power rates before choosing final unit counts
Check all hatches, maintenance, player collision, lighting and egress in game
Only export/import native NBT after target mapping and authorized disposable-world test
